name: Key contract terms
description: Core commercial terms for a services agreement

fields.name: parties
fields.query: Who are the contracting parties? Return each party's full legal name.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.query: What is the effective date of this agreement?
fields.instructions: Answer in YYYY-MM-DD format if possible.

fields.name: term_years
fields.query: What is the initial term of the agreement, in years?

fields.name: monthly_fee
fields.query: What is the recurring monthly fee in USD, as a number?

fields.name: governing_law
fields.query: Which jurisdiction's law governs this agreement?
